assessments.vivaInput: Pehle main main switch isolate karunga aur phase tester se check karunga power off hai. Fir multimeter se continuity test karunga short circuit dhoondhne ke liye. Compressor winding ka resistance check karunga aur MCB rating verify karunga ki 16A C-curve hai ya nahi. Saath hi 2.5 sq mm copper wire earthing connection check karunga.

aiEvaluation.recommendation: Recommended for NSQF Level 3 Certification under RPL Category A.

ppeCompliance.remarks: Candidate wearing required dielectric gloves and protective gear during work demonstration.

nosResults.title: Select, inspect and prepare electrical tools and materials

performanceCriteria.description: PC1.1: Verify insulation rating of hand tools before initiating work
performanceCriteria.evidence: Verified through practical demonstration and verbal explanation.

performanceCriteria.description: PC1.2: Select correct wire gauge (1.5 sq mm, 2.5 sq mm, 4 sq mm) according to circuit load specifications
performanceCriteria.evidence: Verified through practical demonstration and verbal explanation.

performanceCriteria.description: PC1.3: Inspect test instruments (multimeter, continuity tester) for zero error and calibration
performanceCriteria.evidence: Verified through practical demonstration and verbal explanation.

performanceCriteria.description: PC1.4: Prepare PVC conduits and junction boxes free from sharp burrs
performanceCriteria.evidence: Verified through practical demonstration and verbal explanation.

performanceCriteria.description: PC2.1: Strip cable ends without notching or damaging copper conductor strands
performanceCriteria.evidence: Verified through practical demonstration and verbal explanation.

performanceCriteria.description: PC2.2: Make secure mechanical and electrical connections using proper crimping lugs and terminal screws
performanceCriteria.evidence: Verified through practical demonstration and verbal explanation.

performanceCriteria.description: PC2.3: Route cables inside PVC/casing conduits maintaining minimum bend radius
performanceCriteria.evidence: Verified through practical demonstration and verbal explanation.

performanceCriteria.description: PC2.4: Mount and level switchboards, MCBs (Miniature Circuit Breakers), and socket outlets securely
performanceCriteria.evidence: Verified through practical demonstration and verbal explanation.

performanceCriteria.description: PC2.5: Connect earth lead securely to 3-pin sockets and main earthing terminal
performanceCriteria.evidence: Verified through practical demonstration and verbal explanation.

nosResults.feedback: Demonstrates sound practical familiarity with Install wiring, switchboards, and distribution systems. Standard safety precautions followed.

nosResults.title: Perform basic earthing and circuit continuity testing

performanceCriteria.description: PC3.1: Carry out continuity test of Phase, Neutral, and Earth conductors using multimeter
performanceCriteria.evidence: Verified through practical demonstration and verbal explanation.

performanceCriteria.description: PC3.2: Verify polarity of live and neutral at all socket outlets
performanceCriteria.evidence: Verified through practical demonstration and verbal explanation.

performanceCriteria.description: PC3.3: Inspect earthing electrode and ensure proper connection to main distribution board
performanceCriteria.evidence: Verified through practical demonstration and verbal explanation.

performanceCriteria.description: PC3.4: Test insulation resistance between live-neutral and live-earth using megohmmeter
performanceCriteria.evidence: Verified through practical demonstration and verbal explanation.

nosResults.feedback: Demonstrates sound practical familiarity with Perform basic earthing and circuit continuity testing. Standard safety precautions followed.

nosResults.title: Health, safety, and emergency procedures at electrical work sites

performanceCriteria.description: PC4.1: Follow Lock-Out/Tag-Out (LOTO) and de-energization verification procedures prior to contact
performanceCriteria.evidence: Verified through practical demonstration and verbal explanation.

performanceCriteria.description: PC4.2: Don appropriate PPE (gloves, helmet, dielectric footwear) at all work times
performanceCriteria.evidence: Verified through practical demonstration and verbal explanation.

performanceCriteria.description: PC4.3: Demonstrate first-aid response for electric shock and knowledge of CO2/Dry Powder fire extinguishers
performanceCriteria.evidence: Verified through practical demonstration and verbal explanation.

performanceCriteria.description: PC4.4: Keep workplace clean, free of moisture and trip hazards
performanceCriteria.evidence: Verified through practical demonstration and verbal explanation.

nosResults.feedback: Requires minor theoretical reinforcement on standard procedures for Health, safety, and emergency procedures at electrical work sites.

strengths: Extensive hands-on tool handling and muscle memory acquired through informal experience.
Good awareness of basic workplace safety and electrical isolation procedures.
Clear articulation of troubleshooting steps under domestic fault conditions.
gapAreas: Formal documentation and wiring schematic reading according to Indian Standards (IS 3043).
Exact mathematical calculations for cable derating factors under high ambient temperatures.
bridgeTrainingModules: Module 3: Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) Earthing & Protective Device Specifications
Module 5: Digital recordkeeping and formal job card maintenance
